description:
Learn Japanese by reading the manga and novels you love. Tap any word to see what it means, fully offline. Mekuru can even read the Japanese on your manga pages, right on your iPhone or iPad, so you can tap words inside the speech bubbles (on-device OCR, Pro).

◆ TAP ANY WORD IN YOUR MANGA
• On-device OCR finds and reads the text in speech bubbles, offline (Pro)
• Scan the page you're on, or a whole volume that keeps going when you leave the app
• Already use mokuro? Open mokuro-processed manga, or CBZ files with mokuro data, and tap words right away, free
• Single page, two-page spread, or vertical scroll
• Auto-crop page margins (Pro), or use your own OCR server (Pro)

◆ READ NOVELS THE WAY THEY'RE PRINTED
• Vertical text (tategaki) or horizontal, right-to-left or left-to-right
• Turn pages, or scroll through each chapter
• Furigana your way: off, the book's own, all kanji, only kanji above your JLPT level, or only kanji you haven't learned on WaniKani
• Save a copy of any book as an EPUB with furigana added
• Bookmarks, highlights (Pro), and your place restored every time
• Sepia and dark themes, Mincho or Gothic type, font size, and margins

◆ THOUSANDS OF FREE BOOKS
• Over 17,000 public-domain classics from Aozora Bunko
• Free graded readers from Tadoku, written for learners
• Sort by estimated JLPT level, length, or popularity, and download in one tap

◆ AN OFFLINE DICTIONARY THAT UNDERSTANDS GRAMMAR
• Recognizes conjugated verbs and compound words, so you get the entry you meant
• One tap installs a full Japanese-English dictionary with word frequency
• Add KANJIDIC, stroke order (KanjiVG), pitch accent, or your own Yomitan-compatible dictionaries
• Pitch accent and frequency at a glance
• Search in kana, kanji, or romaji

◆ UNDERSTAND THE WHOLE SENTENCE
• Translate the sentence around any word, privately on your device
• Into English, Spanish, Indonesian, or Simplified Chinese

◆ TURN WORDS INTO FLASHCARDS
• Save words together with the sentence you found them in
• Send cards to AnkiMobile, or to Anki on your computer with AnkiConnect
• Export your words as CSV

◆ WATCH YOUR READING GROW
• Reading time, characters read, and words added
• A reading heatmap, lookup rate, and vocabulary growth over time

◆ YOUR LIBRARY, YOUR WAY
• Import EPUB, PDF, and CBZ files from the Files app
• Download books from your own Komga or Kavita server, with reading progress synced both ways; downloads keep going when you leave the app
• Sort books into collections
• Turn image-only EPUBs into manga, and export manga as CBZ
• Back up your whole library to one file

◆ MADE FOR JAPANESE LEARNERS
Mekuru is built for extensive reading (tadoku) and immersion. Reading real Japanese is one of the best ways to learn kanji, grammar, and vocabulary in context, from JLPT N5 beginners with graded readers to advanced learners reading light novels without a paper dictionary.

◆ FREE AND OPEN SOURCE
Mekuru is free and open source (AGPL), with no ads and no account to create. An optional one-time Pro purchase unlocks on-device manga OCR, your own OCR server, manga auto-crop, and book highlights.

App interface in English, Spanish, Indonesian, and Simplified Chinese.

Mekuru (めくる) means "to turn the page": less time with a dictionary, more time reading Japanese.
promotionalText: Tap any word in manga or novels for an instant offline definition. Start with 17,000+ free books, translate tricky sentences, and send words to Anki.
